title: Dinner Ran Into His Stump. Why Work Again? 🐇 | An Ancient Fable
tiktok_title: A free dinner ran into his stump. So he stopped working.
caption:
A hare ran into his tree stump… so why ever work again? 🐇 An old fable about luck, laziness and an empty rice bowl.

#talesinink #moralstories #fable #ukiyoe #shorts #hardwork #mindset #storytime
moral: Luck visits once. Work feeds you every day.
